title: Accelerating Bertotti-Robinson Black Holes in a Uniform Magnetic Field
summary: We study the Hawking temperature, geodesic motion, and observable signatures of the accelerating Bertotti-Robinson (BR) spacetime, a vacuum black-hole solution deformed by a uniform magnetic field $B$ and an acceleration parameter $α$. In the timelike sector, we derive the effective potential for massive particles, determine the specific energy and angular momentum for equatorial circular orbits, and determine how $(B,α)$ shifts the ISCO; we also illustrate representative trajectories of massive particles.
